text:
```yaml
name: Security Scan

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]

jobs:
  security-scan:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.11'

      - name: Run security scanner
        id: security_scan
        run: |
          set -e
          python scripts/scan_plugin.py . || SCAN_EXIT=$?
          SCAN_EXIT=${SCAN_EXIT:-0}
          if [ "$SCAN_EXIT" -eq 1 ]; then
            echo "Security scan found BLOCK findings. Failing CI."
            exit 1
          elif [ "$SCAN_EXIT" -eq 2 ]; then
            echo "Security scan found WARN findings. Please review."
            exit 0
          fi
```
